questions.prompt: What is the main news in the article?
options: A survey shows how rural families use public services.
A company plans its first broadband project in Oxfordshire.
A finished project brings broadband access to rural communities.
A report compares broadband prices in towns and villages.
questions.explanationZh: 新闻重点是北牛津郡全光纤网络建设已经完成，为乡村社区提供接入条件。文章没有公布上网行为调查或价格比较。
questions.promptZh: 文章主要报道了什么新闻？

questions.prompt: What does the figure of 3,880 refer to?
options: Homes and business premises with access to the northern network.
Households that have already paid for the northern broadband service.
Homes and business premises covered by both completed projects.
Customers waiting for work on the southern network to begin.
questions.explanationZh: 3,880指北部项目完成后可以接入网络的住宅和营业场所。第9至10句特别区分了“可以接入”和“已经购买服务”，并未报告已付费用户数。

questions.prompt: What reason does the article give for the difficulty of rural broadband work?
options: The project needs to serve public services before it can serve homes.
The northern network must use connections from the unfinished southern project.
The supplier has to wait for every household to buy a service.
The villages are far apart and some locations are difficult to reach.
questions.explanationZh: 第6句直接说明，距离和较难到达的位置使乡村宽带扩建更有挑战。其他选项中的原因没有出现在文章中。
questions.promptZh: 文章指出，乡村宽带建设困难的原因是什么？

questions.prompt: What can we conclude by comparing the northern and southern projects?
options: Both projects are complete, but only northern customers can sign up.
The expected total includes a southern project that is still being built.
The southern project has already connected all of the 9,300 premises.
The northern project alone accounts for the full £23.1 million support.
questions.explanationZh: 北部项目已完成，南部项目仍在施工；约9,300处和2,310万英镑都属于两个合同合计的范围。因此，合计预期中包含尚未完工的南部部分，不能当成已全部完成的结果。
questions.promptZh: 比较北部和南部项目，我们可以得出什么结论？
